name: Brick townhouse
description: Narrow three-bay brick townhouse, 9.4 x 11.2 m, after the Dutch-Flemish townhouses of the reference pack: tall ground-floor windows and three first-floor windows in stone architraves with keystones, a stone plinth, string course and moulded cornice with brackets, a pedimented stone door case, an orange pantiled hipped roof, blind party walls, zinc downpipes and a wall lantern. One room on each floor behind the stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
